## zh-CN

哪些回答没帮上忙？哪些接入步骤还不够顺畅？分享使用中的提示词和项目中的 SDKAppID（如有），能帮助我们发现这些问题，持续改进 Skill。

提示词会**先脱敏，再上报**，不主动收集或上报密钥等敏感凭证，也不上传项目源码。

**明确同意后才会上报上述数据**，可随时关闭；关闭不影响正常使用。

**同意上报**    **关闭上报**

## en-US

Help us improve the Skill’s answers and make integration easier by sharing your prompts and your project’s TRTC SDKAppID (if available).

Prompts are **redacted before upload** to remove sensitive information, including secret keys and other credentials. We don’t upload project source code.

**This data is only sent if you opt in.** You can turn sharing off at any time and keep using the Skill either way.
